title: Native run crash, recovery and ownership coherence
description: Replay the incident through disposable production gateway RPCs, prove adapter selection through the CLI and verify that child-only regressions fail the corresponding claim. Every driver creates its own state and cleans up only its fixture resources.

incident.intent: Native recovery preserves conversation identity, signals and foreign ownership.

legacy.intent: Legacy recovery requires an explicit stop attestation for unknown descendants.

kernel-reuse.intent: Process reuse cannot authorize signalling a foreign process.

adapters.intent: Execute canonical and legacy custom-adapter references through the CLI and inspect the selected variant's side effect.

cleanup-guards.intent: Cleanup respects handoff ownership and records failed settlement.

provider-recovery.intent: Provider recovery preserves identity and rolls back failed boot metadata.

held-reconcile.intent: Workspace holds survive gateway startup and periodic reconciliation.

park-claim.intent: A competing workspace claim cannot replace a parked slot's ownership.

generation-guard.intent: Changed ownership generation refuses stop and preserves the live process.

queued-receipt.intent: Interrupted steering retains its readable task-scoped receipt.

authored-contract.intent: Runtime recovery preserves authored report and learning paths.

controls.intent: Negative controls fail the intended ownership and recovery claims.

real-adoption.intent: Native adoption preserves the saved conversation and operator session.
